item.title: Facet‐Induced Electron‐Bridge Enables Enhanced LiO 2 ‐Mediated Reaction Kinetics for Stable Lithium‐Oxygen Batteries
item.description:
مهندسی پل الکترونی القا شده توسط وجه کریستالی با میدان داخلی Mott-Schottky، سینتیک واکنش LiO2 را بهبود داده و چرخهپذیری باتری لیتیوم-اکسیژن را با اضافهولتاژ کاهشیافته افزایش میدهد.
Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work introduces facet-induced electron-bridge engineering via a Mott–Schottky built-in electric field to enhance LiO₂-mediated kinetics in Li–O₂ batteries. By tailoring electron density and sorption microenvironments, it precisely controls Li₂O₂ nucleation, growth, and decomposition, enabling extended cycle life and reduced overpotential. The strategy offers a general principle for accelerating electron transfer and regulating intermediates through crystal-plane and interfacial engineering.
🏷 lithium-oxygen battery · LiO2 intermediate · electron bridge · Mott-Schottky · facet engineering

item.title: Spatially Orchestrated Ion‐Electron‐Thermal Transport in an Ultralight Fibrous Copper Current Collector for Lithium Metal Batteries
item.description:

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in an ultralight, conductive-gradient fibrous copper current collector that spatially orchestrates ion, electron, and thermal transport via asymmetric Cu deposition on a porous nanofiber membrane. This design suppresses dendrites and volume swings, enabling 2000 h cycling and 82.66% capacity retention after 300 cycles, offering a mass-efficient platform for high-energy lithium metal batteries.
🏷 lithium metal battery · current collector · fibrous architecture · ion-electron-thermal transport · Li deposition

item.title: Defect‐Free Transfer Principles for Scalable, Thin Garnet‐Based Hybrid Solid Electrolytes in Solid‐State Batteries
item.description:
با تعیین معیارهای ترمودینامیکی بر پایه پارامترهای حلالیت هانسن، الکترولیتهای هیبریدی نازک و بدون نقص LLZTO با ضخامت ۱۵ میکرومتر و مساحت ۱۲۰ سانتیمتر مربع برای باتریهای حالت جامد ساخته شد.
Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This work establishes thermodynamic design principles using Hansen solubility parameters to guide defect-free fabrication of thin garnet-based hybrid solid electrolytes. The criteria enable scalable 15 µm-thin, 120 cm² transfer-printed electrolytes with enhanced Li+ transport, cycling stability, and thermal stability in coin and pouch cells. This provides a generalizable framework for scalable manufacturing of high-performance solid-state batteries.
🏷 garnet solid electrolyte · hybrid solid electrolyte · transfer printing · Hansen solubility parameters · solid-state battery

item.title: Dual‐Functional PDA/CMC‐Li Supramolecular Bridging Networks Unlock Trans‐Phase Li + Conduction in Composite Solid Electrolytes for High‐Performance Lithium Metal Batteries
item.description:

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work introduces dual-functional CMC-Li supramolecular bridges linking PDA-modified LLZAO fillers in PVDF-HFP, simultaneously dispersing fillers and regulating ion solvation. This mitigates space-charge layers, enabling trans-phase Li⁺ conduction through ceramic bulk rather than sluggish interfaces. The result is dendrite suppression, 1400 h cycling stability, and high-capacity retention, offering a generalizable paradigm for advanced composite solid electrolytes.
🏷 composite solid electrolyte · lithium metal battery · supramolecular bridging · LLZAO filler · trans-phase Li+ conduction
